scope: Every examples/scenarios/<name>/<name>.js entry point that declares TRECH_HOOKS; companion declarations are inspected together

statuses.operator_backed: Normal material-state path uses engine inference operators; authored teachers are audit-only.
statuses.operator_partial: At least one normal-path law is operator-backed, but the named residual still awaits an engine prerequisite/model.
statuses.reference_only: Normal path still contains an authored comparison law and remains an explicit roadmap migration.
statuses.no_active_material_law: Hook performs configuration, API demonstration, bookkeeping, or validation without a material-state law.
statuses.operator_native: Born operator-backed: the scenario never contained an authored material law, so there is no teacher to retire and no reference switch to keep. Its normal path is engine inference from the first commit.

examples/scenarios/water_salt_recipe/wat.note: Calls reusable solution process libraries; no built-in kinetics or models. The supplied recipe blocks on missing operators and emits no invented spatial motion.

examples/scenarios/aerodynamics_referenc.residual: Independent ideal-gas Euler comparison only. Exact periodic entropy/shear grid/CFL verification exists; obstacle/shock/acoustic accuracy, external anchors with uncertainty, particle-derived aerodynamic scale lift, thermal coupling and structural failure remain unavailable.
examples/scenarios/aerodynamics_referenc.note: The reference solver is explicitly separate from Geant4 transport and must not become a synthetic training truth. Future learned behaviour needs its own validated path.

examples/scenarios/nacl_dehydration_refe.residual: Illustrative capacity/attachment lattice comparison only; calibrated solubility/kinetics, nucleation/morphology anchors, particle-derived phase lift and metal heat-treatment response remain unavailable.
examples/scenarios/nacl_dehydration_refe.note: Exact parcel conservation is an implementation check, not experimental validation of NaCl crystallization.

examples/scenarios/chemistry_mode/chemis.note: Authored structures and optional conserved inventories; supplied hazard models run in the engine. No built-in reaction/stability/valence law; transferable chemistry models and atomistic paths remain roadmap work. Particle response uses the shared Geant4-trained helper.

examples/scenarios/cnt_logic_gates/cnt_l.residual: CNTFET conductance and Fermi turn-on forward laws

examples/scenarios/elephants_toothpaste/.residual: catalytic reaction, heat, trapping and foam-drainage evolution

examples/scenarios/glass_from_sand/glass.note: Material-creation scenario. The default physics_source=operator runs the distilled trained per-material thermal/chemistry family (measured meso hull + independent holdout); the hand-authored illustrative family it was distilled from is reachable only with physics_source=reference and is the harvest/audit teacher. Cell-to-cell conduction deliberately stays in the reference family: its law is exactly linear in the temperature difference.

examples/scenarios/glass_of_water_shaken.residual: PBF neighbour pressure, viscosity and cohesion response

examples/scenarios/h2o_bulk_water/h2o_bu.residual: SPC/E pair forces; SHAKE/RATTLE and integration are numerical prerequisites

examples/scenarios/h2o_cluster_fluid/h2o.residual: flexible-water bond, angle and intermolecular force laws

examples/scenarios/h2o_molecule_stabilit.residual: flexible-water bond and angle force laws

examples/scenarios/lava_lamp/lava_lamp.j.residual: thermal, phase, pair-interface and buoyancy/drag state evolution

examples/scenarios/molecular_series/mole.note: Imposed parameter scans, not material dynamics. Separate QM charge/torsion comparison; new group uses shared Geant4-trained atom response via ctx.evolve and nano composition response via ctx.cascade in trech_molecular_particle.js. Purple halos depend on inferred particle response; no authored molecular potential.

examples/scenarios/polyurethane_foam/pol.residual: default mechanics coupling (opt-in constitutive candidate has failing observer gates) and persistent bond/contact response

examples/scenarios/testscenario_magnetic.residual: Bloch pulse, Curie magnetization and FID forward dynamics
voxel excitation and synthesized readout forward dynamics

examples/scenarios/testscenario_osmotic/.residual: 3D particle transport/crossing and pressure-driven area-conserving membrane response

examples/scenarios/testscenario_pascal/t.residual: 3D particle bath and tensioned sensor-wall patch constitutive response
